references.text: The same principle of impurity from touching the dead bodies of unclean animals, with impurity lasting until evening.
Elaborates on the rules regarding impurity from touching dead animals and the duration of impurity until evening.
Repeats the principle that whoever touches a dead unclean animal becomes unclean until evening.
Extended rules about impurity from touching animals that died naturally, even those of clean species.
Mentions touching carcasses of unclean animals as a source of impurity and guilt.
Concerns impurity from animals that died naturally and the purification process.
Parallel text in Deuteronomy listing unclean animals, including those that walk on paws.
